questions.prompt: Which protocol provides reliable, ordered byte-stream delivery?
questions.explanation: TCP uses acknowledgements and retransmission to deliver data reliably and in order.

questions.prompt: Which OSI layer is responsible for routing packets between networks?
questions.explanation: The network layer (IP) handles logical addressing and routing.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the TCP three-way handshake?
options: Establish a connection and synchronise sequence numbers
questions.explanation: SYN, SYN-ACK and ACK set up state on both ends.

questions.prompt: What does the TCP sliding window primarily control?
options: How much unacknowledged data the sender may have in flight
questions.explanation: The window implements flow control so the sender does not overwhelm the receiver.
